value.message: The Enforce token restriction option limits the client to accessing only the APIs specified in the REST API Access Policies. If you unselect it, the client can access other REST APIs based on the user ACL permissions.
The field lifespan is the time in seconds and represents the duration for which an access token remains valid after it is issued. Default value is: 1800 seconds (30 minutes).
